summary: No installer-harm signals identified in velabuild@2.1.1
details: Package velabuild@2.1.1 was examined and no install-time or import-time behaviors indicating credential theft, remote code execution, silent relay of caller data, dropper activity, or backdoor mechanisms were identified in the shipped contents. No hardcoded attacker network destinations, no lifecycle-hook fetch-and-execute, and no reads of installer-owned secret paths were observed.
